verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent for C and C++, and design-to-app generation is a fair capability to ask of a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence covers repository editing, toolchain verification, headless exec and model configuration. Nothing in it mentions accepting sketches, images or PDF designs as input, or generating an app from them.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
